title: lavandula atlantica
intro: Lavandula atlantica, commonly known as Portuguese lavender, is a flowering plant species in the family Lamiaceae. This plant is known for its calming and soothing properties, which have been used for centuries to promote relaxation, improve sleep quality, and alleviate stress and anxiety. The health benefits of Lavandula atlantica include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and boost the immune system, while its therapeutic actions include sedation, antispasmodic, and antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include linalool, linalyl acetate, and camphor, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
